events.detail_full_en: Due to the impact of vehicle inspections at Kisarazu Station, services on the downbound line (toward Awa-Kamogawa Station) between Kisarazu and Awa-Kamogawa stations were under a suspension of services. However, services resumed around 05:40. Please note that some trains are experiencing delays.
